text:
Maria Gomez: Heads-up: spotted a new vuln chain affecting vLLM 0.6.1 -> protobuf 3.20.x parsing + FlashAttention kernel OOB on Ampere. Link: https://nvd.example/CVE-2026-XXXX. Affects hosted inference and Dedicated. Any immediate mitigations we can do? @Raj @Liz :warning:

Raj Patel: Can you paste the vuln summary and any stack traces you have? need to confirm exploitability path (unauth input vs. privileged).

Maria Gomez: Summary from advisory: 'malformed nested message in protobuf can cause integer overflow leading to OOB read in GPU kernel path when using FlashAttention optimizations; exploitable via crafted model artifact or request in some configs.' Attached log snippet below:
```
2026-03-19T14:02:11Z runtime ERROR: flash_kernel.cu:kernel_dispatch() idx=0 failed memcpy OOB
model_loader: parse_protobuf() failed at field 0x12 size=0xffffffff
```

Liz Chen: If the attacker needs to upload a model artifact to our storage and we block those flows, exploit surface is smaller. But hosted API accepts model uploads for some partners => still risky. I'd vote P1 -> escalate to emergency patch window.

Oliver Nguyen: Quick mitigations to consider now: 1) deny model-upload role to unscoped service accounts (RBAC tweak), 2) add runtime-side input validation to reject big sizes before protobuf parse, 3) roll Triton/vLLM to patched builds that drop the vulnerable protobuf, 4) for Dedicated, block older vLLM image tags in the registries (immutable denylist).

security-bot: New advisory recorded: CVE-2026-XXXX severity=HIGH. Assigned to team: eng-runtime, eng-security. Link: https://security.internal/adv/1840012345

Raj Patel: I can open the RBAC change PR to remove `storage.objects.create` from the runtime service account and enforce signed-URL uploads for customer artifacts. That cuts model-upload attack vector fast.

Maria Gomez: Good. Also we should enable stricter audit logging for model load/unload + kernel failures to surface attempted exploits. Add a permanent audit marker for any `model_load` events and log the user/service id + artifact checksum.

Liz Chen: For patch rollout: propose canary 5% of Dedicated hosts + all hosted traffic routed to CPU fallback for 2 hours during patch. We'll need config knobs: `runtime.kernel.fallback=cpu` and `routing.canary.percent=5`. Can we turn on kv-cache bypass to reduce complexity while patching?

Oliver Nguyen: KV-cache bypass is fine for short window. Also flag: KMS integration — does rotating/deprecating keys help? probably not directly for this vuln, but rotate any keys potentially used to sign model uploads. Follow up: confirm whether model artifacts are stored encrypted with customer KMS keys in Private deployments; if so, owners must rotate and re-encrypt after patch.

Maria Gomez: I'll draft customer notice for Dedicated + Private tonight. Draft items: impact, mitigation steps, expected downtime (canary + rolling restarts), and recommended actions (rotate artifact keys if on-customer KMS).

Raj Patel: PR opened: https://git.internal/rb/1234 removing `storage.objects.create` from `runtime-sa`. Added migration plan to fallback to signed URLs. Will coordinate with deploy team for quick rollback.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline started for runtime-sa RBAC change. Pipeline ID: dp-9876. Status: running.

Liz Chen: I'll prepare the Triton/vLLM patched images and push to `redwood/patches:vllm-0.6.2-triton-2.21`. Need eng-sre for image promotion.

Oliver Nguyen: Noted — tagging eng-sre, eng-runtime, and customer-ops for coordination.

Maria Gomez: Action items summary: 1) Raj - RBAC PR (in flight), 2) Liz - build & push patched images, 3) Oliver - registry denylist + canary plan, 4) Maria - customer comms + audit logging changes, 5) eng-sre - schedule rolling restarts. Deadline: EOD UTC today for initial mitigations.

Raj Patel: Ack. I'll also add an emergency rule in WAF to block suspicious protobuf payloads patterns as a short-term protective measure.

Liz Chen: ETA for images ~4h. Will mark images as `quarantine` until promoted.

Maria Gomez: Thanks team. If anyone sees exploit attempts, drop logs here and tag @Maria. I'll update the security incident tracker. :thumbsup:

Oliver Nguyen: +1 — keeping this channel for triage updates only.

security-bot: Incident tracker updated: INC-2026-324 created and linked to CVE-2026-XXXX.

Maria Gomez: Closing loop: schedule emergency postmortem once mitigations verified.
